note: D41 display sidecar for edge_list.json: names, pin kinds and labels, clock times. Not a contract. pins[i] describes pinned_occupancy[i]; its unique_label tells blocks apart that share a label; its faculty names its teacher with the initials its label shows. Every cohort's label is unique; batches gives each division's batch ids; initials are per year, 'unscoped' for manual mappings with no year. Names carry no title.
